summary: Jotty is a self-hosted alternative for organising file-based notes and checklists. It provides a lightweight interface to manage personal documentation stored directly on your server.
goodFor: It suits individuals looking for a minimalist, file-backed system for personal notes and tasks without heavier database dependencies.
watchOut: The AGPL-3.0 licence may impose copyleft restrictions if you modify and distribute the code, and the project occupies a crowded space alongside mature alternatives.
deployNotes: As a Docker-based application, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes to ensure your note files survive container restarts, alongside a reverse proxy for TLS termination.
